description: Canon 300D digital camera: normalized R, G and B channel spectral sensitivities (400-720 nm, 10 nm steps) from the RIT Camera Spectral Sensitivity Database (Jiang et al. 2013); plus the transmission of the camera's internal UV/IR-cut ('hot mirror') filter as measured by Kolari Vision on filters removed during full-spectrum conversions.
short_description: Canon 300D RGB sensitivities (Jiang et al. 2013), UV/IR-cut filter
facility_description: Digital cameras (DSLRs, mirrorless, compact, industrial, cinema and phone cameras) whose RGB channel spectral sensitivities or internal IR/UV-cut filter transmissions have been measured.
notes: RGB curves checked this session: NJM values are identical (max abs diff 0) to the 'Canon 300D' entry of http://www.gujinwei.org/research/camspec/camspec_database.txt. Block band: Kolari page has a chart titled 'Canon 300D ICF Transmission' (image chart only; the NJM curve is a digitization, attributed here by camera name only since SVO gives no ProfileReference). Licence set to the stricter source (Kolari: no redistribution grant) because the Block band comes from Kolari; the RGB bands alone are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (RIT).
